title: Re-calibrated Contrastive Loss for Transformation-Aware Prompt Conditioning in Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.06967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ensuring effective transfer learning for vision-language models without compromising their generalization performance is crucial. However, many existing methods overlook data characteristics and simply reuse the training strategies adopted during pre-training. Specifically, they treat same-class samples as distinct instances and transform images independently of their paired text prompts, which makes model learning more difficult. We address these limitations through transformation-aware prompt conditioning and a re-calibrated contrastive loss. Fixed text descriptors identify the transformations applied to paired images, providing transformation-level consistency without altering class semantics. This design aligns the image and text branches at the transformation level, enabling richer representations while preserving the models' ability to generalize. In addition, our loss function mitigates positive-gradient dilution in soft-target

translated_title: 面向视觉-语言模型中变换感知提示条件化的重新校准对比损失
translated_abstract: 确保视觉-语言模型在有效迁移学习的同时不损害其泛化性能至关重要。然而，许多现有方法忽视了数据特性，只是简单地复用预训练阶段采用的训练策略。具体来说，它们将同类样本视为相互独立的实例，并且在变换图像时不考虑其配对的文本提示，这使得模型学习变得更加困难。我们通过变换感知的提示条件化和重新校准的对比损失来解决这些局限性。固定的文本描述符用于识别施加在配对图像上的变换，从而在不改变类别语义的前提下提供变换级别的一致性。这种设计在变换级别上对齐图像分支和文本分支，在保持模型泛化能力的同时获得更丰富的表示。此外，我们的损失函数缓解了软目标中的正梯度稀释问题（摘要内容在此处不完整）。
tldr: 该论文提出变换感知的提示条件化与重新校准的对比损失，利用固定文本描述符识别图像变换并在变换级别对齐图像与文本分支，从而在不损害视觉-语言模型泛化能力的前提下提升迁移学习效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes transformation-aware prompt conditioning and a re-calibrated contrastive loss that uses fixed text descriptors to identify image transformations and aligns the image and text branches at the transformation level, enhancing transfer learning in vision-language models without compromising their generalization ability.
